question: In a certain code language, HALT is coded as 164, and MOP is coded as 132. How will GOBLET be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of position value of letters) × Number of letters in the word

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f911b143d49acd773795fc23a7298b4faeaf5a8fcea9dffb98a7dd54c4af634f.png] and 41 × 4 = 164
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc28d9b35a71906a3e2ff0c7aa0aa7bb1bda07598daffde16be9d32240af1882.png] and 44 × 3 = 132

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3494132ccb4812160ec2928a9a04e0622431f718f71b6b1933f2a930a898864b.png] and 61 × 6 = 366

Hence, '**366**' is the correct answer.
